verdict.rationale: Apple's docs claim unified memory lets M5 devices 'run larger AI models completely on device' and cite LM Studio/local LLM platforms, but the current M5 is only the base chip capped at 32GB memory with 153GB/s bandwidth — community analysis explicitly states this is 'not enough to run viable open source LLM models properly' and that capacity is 'an even bigger problem, at 32GB max,' with commenters waiting for an M5 Max (128–256GB) to make 70B-class local inference viable. Missing for 10: a shipped high-memory (Pro/Max) M5 SKU, published bandwidth for that SKU, and hands-on 70B-quantized inference benchmarks confirming practical throughput.
